title: repo_manifest
description: Identity and provenance of one candidate source tree entering the pipeline.

manifest_id.description: Stable id for this intake; derived from device_id + revision + root digest.

device_id.description: Stable identifier of the producing device (e.g. chromebook-crostini, moto-4-5g-2024).

source_root.description: Absolute path as seen on the producing device. Never silently rewritten.

revision.description: Git revision, or 'norev:<content-digest>' for an unversioned tree.

intake_status.description: Lifecycle state. Only 'verified' manifests may feed clustering.

truncated.description: True when a scan bound (count/depth/time) cut the walk short.
